name: Mocros
overview:
In the eight-part series Mocros, Moroccan-Dutch Souf leads a double life. While his family thinks he is heading for a career as an aerospace engineer, Souf secretly dreams of a future as an actor.

His friends Mo, Willy, and Mehmet are the only ones who understand the dilemma he finds himself in. When Souf's lies begin to pile up, he must make a choice before he loses everything: his friends, his first major film role, the love of his life, and his family's trust.
